Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating requirements for scoliosis screening in schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to scoliosis screening in schools; creating a newsection; and repealing RCW 28A.210.180, 28A.210.190, 28A.210.200,28A.210.210, 28A.210.220, 28A.210.240, and 28A.210.250.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that many schooldistricts in Washington are experiencing profound shortages of healthpersonnel to serve the needs of students. Recent increases inresponsibilities for health planning, the demands of delivering healthservices, and increases in the severity of the health issues facing thestudent population have strained school health resources. The legislature finds that it is an inefficient use of limitedschool health resources to require that scoliosis screening of childrenbe conducted at schools. While a child affected with severe scoliosiscan experience serious health issues, diagnosis and treatment are mostappropriately managed through a primary care provider. As Washingtoncontinues to achieve greater rates of health care coverage for itschildren, the availability of these screening services through medicalhomes will continue to increase.
